name: highnoon-cast-turns
comment: High Noon Rating Agency, the character bible v1: five more cells per character (three-quarter, profile, back, 85 mm portrait, the action tell), each referencing that character's FRONT from highnoon-cast-fronts. Run after the fronts exist; --parallel 6 is safe (no cell references another cell of this board).
subject: Live-action documentary realism, a full-body character study for a feature film: shot on a full-frame cinema camera with a 50 mm lens, at high noon in the dusty main street of an 1880s frontier town, the sun directly overhead so the only shadow is a hard short pool at the boots, a bleached pale sky, weathered timber storefronts soft behind, the figure centred and fully in frame head to toe, natural skin and real fabric, fine film grain, true-to-life colour, stunning, gallery-grade cinematography. No text, no logos, no real or recognisable person: a designed character.
negative: text, letters, logos, brand names, watermark, cartoon, animation, illustration, CGI look, plastic skin, warped hands, extra limbs, extra fingers, celebrity likeness, real person, gun, pistol, revolver, rifle, cropped feet, cropped head, modern clothing, sneakers, sunglasses

styles.label: The Keeper, candidate A: the Assayer: three-quarter
styles.style: EXACTLY the same character as the reference image (same face, same hair, same clothes, same colours, same props). THE KEEPER, CANDIDATE A, THE ASSAYER: a lean man in his late forties, about 1.85 m, a sun-lined handsome face, clean-shaven, strong jaw, silver at the temples in short dark hair, dark brows, calm grey eyes; a fitted charcoal wool frock coat, an ink-black waistcoat, a crisp ivory shirt with a black silk cravat, a small brass five-point-star seal pin on the left lapel, a gold pocket-watch chain across the waistcoat, a brass jeweller's loupe on a black cord around his neck, a black flat-crowned wide-brimmed hat, polished black boots; in his right hand a heavy brass hand-stamp with a turned wooden handle (a seal stamp), his left hand resting on the watch. No gun, no holster. Unhurried, very still, a faint knowing half-smile. Seen from a THREE-QUARTER front angle, standing, full body head to toe.

styles.label: Doc Pullman, the Scammer (the rug puller): three-quarter

styles.label: Miss Honey Lockett, the Honeypotter: three-quarter
styles.style: EXACTLY the same character as the reference image (same face, same hair, same clothes, same colours, same props). THE HONEYPOTTER, MISS HONEY LOCKETT: a woman in her thirties, about 1.65 m, a sweet round freckled face, rosy cheeks, a fixed gentle smile that does not reach her wide unblinking blue eyes, honey-blonde hair pinned up under a straw beekeeper's hat with its white veil lifted back; a high-collared amber-gold prairie dress with a white lace collar and cuffs, a white apron sticky and stained amber at the hem, fingerless brown leather work gloves glossy with honey; she carries a wooden tray of six unlabelled amber glass honey jars in both hands, honey dripping off the rim of the tray with a few flies stuck in it, one bee on her veil; behind her back, hooked in the crook of her right elbow and half hidden, a rusted iron bear trap with its jaws open. Welcoming, motherly, perfectly still. Seen from a THREE-QUARTER front angle, standing, full body head to toe.

styles.label: "Forty Hands" Buell, the Bundler: three-quarter
styles.style: EXACTLY the same character as the reference image (same face, same hair, same clothes, same colours, same props). THE BUNDLER, FORTY HANDS BUELL: a huge barrel-chested man in his fifties, about 1.95 m, a heavy iron-grey beard, small hard eyes under a low heavy brow, bald beneath his hat, a bull neck; an oxblood leather waistcoat over a collarless grey shirt with the sleeves rolled over forearms like hams, a leather bandolier across his chest that holds forty identical small brown leather coin pouches where cartridges would go, coils of rope on his belt, canvas trousers, heavy boots, a black flat-brimmed hat, a branding iron hanging from his belt; in each fist a wooden marionette crossbar, with taut strings running down out of his hands to a row of small identical wooden puppet figures in identical little black hats standing in the dust at his boots. THE DEGEN, JESSE MOONSHOT KAINE: a wiry sunburnt young man of twenty-four, about 1.75 m, sleepless red-rimmed eyes, a patchy two-day beard, a grin far too wide, hair plastered to his forehead; a sweat-stained collarless off-white shirt, bright red suspenders, a sun-faded blue striped serape thrown over his left shoulder, a crumpled brown hat with a bullet hole through the crown, dusty brown trousers, one boot with a spur and one without, his left hand wrapped in a grubby bandage; a fan of five playing cards in his right hand, a fistful of chipped clay poker chips in his bandaged left, a lucky rabbit's foot on a string at his belt, a half-empty bottle in his trouser pocket. Vibrating with energy, leaning in, mid-laugh. Seen from BEHIND, back to the camera, full body head to toe, every prop still in hand.
